title: Refresh button on each market card of the manager page
notes:
The four cards across the top of the manager page (date and weather, Bitcoin, Tether in toman, gold; docs/markets/) only refresh on their own schedule. When one shows 'fetch failed' (seen on Bitcoin), there is no way to retry.

- A small refresh icon in each card's corner. A click refetches that card only. It is an iconButton with a tooltip and an accessible name (Refresh Bitcoin).
- While the fetch runs the icon spins and a second click does nothing; the card keeps its last good answer on screen until the new one lands, as it does today on a failed read.
- A failure shows the error line as today; the icon stays, so the user can try again.
- Keyboard first (conventions-rule-1): a manager-scoped key refreshes all four cards (a row in src/shared/keys/actions.ts, so help, settings and which-key read it). Each card's button is also reachable with Tab.
- A manual refresh resets that card's timer, so the scheduled fetch does not fire right after.
- The decision (ignore while in flight, reset the timer) goes in a small module with a test (workflow-rule-2). docs/markets updated, help updated, minor version bump.

Shipped in #169: a refresh button in each of the four cards' corner (date card reads the weather), spins while reading, ignores presses in flight, resets that card's half-hour timer; Alt+R refreshes all four from any manager section; Tab reaches each button and Enter/Space presses it. markets:read now reads one card.

comments.body: The date and weather card gets the refresh icon too: it refetches the weather (the date needs no fetch). All four cards, no exceptions.
